verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API provider. Such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or background agent jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows chat, Responses and Messages APIs, tool calls, and connecting external agents like Claude Code. These are developer building blocks or client-side integrations, not a product-native capability to set up autonomous background or recurring automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
